rows.en:
{C:81905701}{C:81958296642D00000000}If Renais hadn't been here,
we'd have been in serious trouble.
Thank you, Renais.

{C:81905901}{C:81958296EE0000000000}I just protected this place.
There's no reason to thank me.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296652D00000000}So what happened?
This place looks all right.

{C:81905801}{C:81958296662D00000000}Mamoru suddenly came here
and tried to steal
the GaoFighGar data.

{C:81905901}{C:81958296EF0000000000}And when I tried to stop him,
he started glowing and went on a rampage.

{C:81905401}{C:81958296672D00000000}Mamoru... I can't believe it.

{C:81905901}{C:81958296F00000000000}Facts are facts.
There's been terrible damage.

{C:81958296F10000000000}The GaoFighGar data was stolen.
What are you going to do, Guy?

{C:81906101}{C:81958296692D00000000}We must recover the GaoFighGar data
no matter what.
Swan!

{C:81905801}{C:819582966A2D00000000}Yes!
I'll track Mamoru's movements.

{C:819582966B2D00000000}...I've found him!
{C:819782830300}Kyoto{C:819782830000} is where he's heading!

{C:81930100}{C:819582966C2D00000000}I'll get the Astante II
ready for launch first!

{C:81905701}{C:819582966D2D00000000}Guy... Are you going to fight Mamoru?

{C:81905401}{C:819582966E2D00000000}There must be a reason for this.
If we can find out what it is,
we shouldn't have to fight.

{C:81905901}{C:81958296F20000000000}I'm coming too.
With you thinking like that, Guy,
there's no telling what might happen.


{x00}

{C:81906301}{C:81958296A62D00000000}I do!
But helping Arma recover
comes first right now.

{C:81958296AA2D00000000}Farewell, Evoluder Guy.
I'm taking Arma with me.

{C:81905401}{C:81958296AB2D00000000}Wait!


{C:81930100}{C:81958296AC2D00000000}Are you all right, Guy?!

{C:81905401}{C:81958296AD2D00000000}I'd like to say yes, but I can barely stand.
Could you take me back to 
{C:819782830300}Tokio{C:819782830000}?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296AE2D00000000}Understood.
We'll hurry back to Tokio.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296AF2D00000000}All right.
Let's carry Guy
to the Astante II.

{C:81958296B02D00000000}...Urgh!
H-he's heavy...

{C:8190A302}{C:81958296B32D00000000}I'll carry him for you.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296B42D00000000}A girl couldn't do it.
...Wait, how can you
lift him so easily?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296B52D00000000}Big brother!
Stop gawking and hurry!

{C:81935A02}{C:81958296BD2D00000000}The people I had fight on your orders
were soundly defeated.
Are you satisfied, Your Excellency Treize?

{C:8193EC01}{C:81958296BE2D00000000}I've received word
from the person I sent
aboard the Astante II.

{C:81958296BF2D00000000}As I thought, justice
appears to be on their side.

{C:81958296C02D00000000}At this rate, all the continents
will be ruled by war...
and eventually perish.

{C:81958296C12D00000000}What will you do,
Meio Plato?

{C:81935A02}{C:81958296C22D00000000}You are a devious one, Your Excellency.
You and your friend
have long since made up your minds.

{C:8193EC01}{C:81958296C42D00000000}Heh...
But if they cannot make it here,
it is merely a theory on paper.

{C:81935A02}{C:81958296C52D00000000}Indeed.

{C:81937B02}{C:81958296C82D00000000}Chief! Chief!
Introduce us already!
Make it flashy and cool!

{C:81906101}{C:81958296C92D00000000}Everyone, while Guy is recovering,
let me introduce our new heroes:
three members of the Defense Class.

{C:81907B02}{C:81958296CA2D00000000}Hey, I'm {C:819782830400}Jin Hyuga{C:819782830000}.
{C:819782830400}Ken-Oh{C:819782830000} is the machine I pilot!

{C:81907C02}{C:81958296CB2D00000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Asuka Tsukishiro{C:819782830000}.
{C:819782830400}Ho-Oh{C:819782830000} is the machine I pilot.
It's nice to meet you all.

{C:81907D02}{C:81958296CC2D00000000}I-I-I'm K-K-{C:819782830400}Koji Hoshiyama{C:819782830000}.
J-J-{C:819782830400}Ju-Oh{C:819782830000} is the machine I pilot.

{C:8190A602}{C:81958296CE2D00000000}Whaaat? You call yourselves the Defense Class,
but there are only three of you!

{C:81909202}{C:81958296CF2D00000000}Even with only three members,
the Ganba Team
has Gambaruger, so it doesn't matter!

{C:8190A602}{C:81958296D12D00000000}I wasn't asking you!
Well, whatever.
My {C:819782830400}Jyakomaru{C:819782830000} is the best!

{C:81907C02}{C:81958296D22D00000000}If our friends in the Defense Class
get together,
we're absolutely invincible too!

{C:81909202}{C:81958296D32D00000000}Then why don't you go find them?

{C:81907B02}{C:81958296D42D00000000}Don't make it sound so easy.
If we could cross the Cloud Sea,
we wouldn't have this problem. Right, Koji?

{C:81907D02}{C:81958296D52D00000000}Y-yeah.
It's a shame, because we'd be stronger
if the Defense Class got together.

{C:81907B02}{C:81958296D62D00000000}If only we could find
our friends in the Defense Class...

{C:81905401}{C:81958296D82D00000000}It certainly is lively in here.

{C:81905701}{C:81958296D92D00000000}Guy!
You mustn't push yourself!

{C:81905401}{C:81958296DA2D00000000}I'm sorry I worried you, Mikoto.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DB2D00000000}Guy!
Are you all right already?

{C:81905401}{C:81958296DC2D00000000}A powerful ally
has come back to us.
Right, Mamoru?

{C:81905501}{C:81958296DD2D00000000}Wahaa!
I'm back, everyone!

{C:81905801}{C:81958296DE2D00000000}Welcome back, Mamoru!

{C:81906101}{C:81958296DF2D00000000}With Mamoru's power,
Guy will be fully recovered!

{C:81900700}{C:81958296E02D00000000}Chief Taiga, is that true?





{x00}

{C:81930400}{C:81958296093400000000}Are you always like that?

{C:81935901}{C:819582966D0100000000}What are you talking about?

{C:81930400}{C:819582960A3400000000}I was just wondering
why you hide your true feelings.
I used to be like that too.

{C:81935901}{C:819582966E0100000000}You too?

{C:81930400}{C:819582960B3400000000}Even a genius pilot
has worries.

{C:81935901}{C:819582966F0100000000}It sounds like you've got your own problems,
but leave me alone.
You're a nuisance.

{C:81930400}{C:819582960D3400000000}...I'm sorry.

{C:819582960E3400000000}I just assumed
that you might understand
how I feel.

{C:81935901}{C:81958296700100000000}Once I know you better,
I'll have tea with you and hear you out.
But only after the fighting's over.

{C:81930400}{C:819582960F3400000000}Thank you, Renais.

It's the one they call Astante II.
What do we do, {C:819782830400}Manjero{C:819782830000}?

{C:81932C01}{C:81958296F62D00000000}Isn't it obvious?

{C:81932E01}{C:81958296FB0000000000}Nobody asked you.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296F82D00000000}I'm picking up a reaction in the Cloud Sea.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296F92D00000000}The Cloud Sea is opening...
It seems they really can
control it at will.

{C:81930700}{C:81958296FA2D00000000}I don't know how it's done,
but it's a real nuisance.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FB2D00000000}I don't know what you're talking about,
but we're leaving for the next continent.

{C:81930A00}{C:81958296FC2D00000000}Where are we going next?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296FD2D00000000}{C:819782830300}Pentagona{C:819782830000} is our next destination.

{C:81933001}{C:81958296FF2D00000000}Have you forgotten?
I forbade you to return.

{C:81932B01}{C:81958296002E00000000}Father!
What has happened to you?!
Why am I not allowed to return?

{C:81933001}{C:81958296012E00000000}There's no helping it now you're back.
But once you've cooled your head,
you will leave at once.

{C:81930D00}{C:81958296022E00000000}Obey your father
quietly, Lord {C:819782830400}Le Caine{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296032E00000000}{C:819782830300}Grados{C:819782830000}'s people must see
you set a proper example.

{C:81958296042E00000000}{C:819782830400}Gresco{C:819782830000} is your commander.
If you cannot obey those orders,
we shall have to consider what to do with you.

{C:81932B01}{C:81958296052E00000000}Why do you obey a man like this?
Father, answer me!

{C:81933001}{C:81958296062E00000000}Leave, {C:819782830400}Le Caine{C:819782830000}.
I will not tell you again.

{C:81932B01}{C:81958296072E00000000}Tch...!
